scope: Per-CVE exploit-surface analysis in V1 LeCayenne single-resto context
context: Single-resto deployment (Le Cayenne) — surfaces = POS (admin staff intranet) + Kiosk (customer touchscreen, in-store LAN) + Customer Mobile/Web (public internet) + Kitchen Display + OSS. No multi-tenant SaaS exposure.

composer_per_cve.title: File Validation Bypass
composer_per_cve.surface: Admin file/image uploads: ItemCategoryImportRequest (Excel xls/xlsx admin import), ItemCategoryRequest+CouponRequest+ItemPhotoUploadRequest+ChangeImageRequest+ThemeRequest+MessageRequest+PushNotificationRequest+NotificationRequest+OfferRequest (image jpg/png) — 10+ FormRequests use 'image' / 'mimes:' validators. Admin-authenticated only.
composer_per_cve.exploit_difficulty: Medium — requires authenticated admin to craft polyglot/malicious file passing image mime check but containing executable payload. Mitigation depends on downstream sanitization (Intervention\Image re-encode) and storage location (public vs. private).
composer_per_cve.v1_lecayenne_impact: LIMITED — admin-only surface, single-resto staff trusted. Not exploitable by kiosk users or public web/mobile customers. Storage on local filesystem inside admin upload directory.
composer_per_cve.fix_path: BLOCKED on Laravel 9 EOL — no 9.x backport. Requires Laravel 10.48.29+ migration. V1.1 track.

composer_per_cve.title: CloudFront Policy Document Injection
composer_per_cve.surface: Grep app/ + config/ for CloudFront / getSignedUrl / signedCookie / UrlSigner = ZERO matches. FoodKing uses AWS SDK only for S3 (file storage) and SES (email — currently disabled). No CloudFront usage.
composer_per_cve.fix_path: DEFER V1.0.X — upgrade aws-sdk to 3.371.4+ when next routine bump.

composer_per_cve.title: S3 Encryption Clients Key Commitment Issues
composer_per_cve.surface: Requires use of S3EncryptionClient/S3EncryptionMultipartUploader. FoodKing uses standard S3 Storage adapter (Filesystem facade). No client-side encryption.

composer_per_cve.title: Weak Encryption
composer_per_cve.surface: Grep app/ for Firebase\JWT / JWT::decode / JWT::encode = ZERO matches. firebase/php-jwt is a transitive dep (likely via google/apiclient or laravel-fcm) — no direct callsites in app code. FoodKing JWT-equivalent = Laravel Sanctum personal access tokens (NOT JWT).
composer_per_cve.v1_lecayenne_impact: NONE in app surface. Could affect FCM push notification token verification IF used internally by a transitive package — verify in V1.0.X.

composer_per_cve.title: Embed extension allowed_domains bypass + DisallowedRawHtml extension bypass via whitespace
composer_per_cve.surface: Grep app/ + resources/ for CommonMark / convertToHtml / MarkdownConverter / Str::markdown = ZERO matches. League/commonmark is a transitive dep (likely via Laravel itself for mail rendering) — no FoodKing markdown rendering of user content.
composer_per_cve.fix_path: DEFER V1.0.X — bump to 2.8.2+ at next routine update.

composer_per_cve.title: ASN1::decodeOID DoS + variable-time HMAC SSH + AES-CBC padding oracle
composer_per_cve.surface: Grep app/ + config/ for phpseclib / SSH2 / SFTP / RSA / Crypt\\AES = ZERO matches. phpseclib is transitive dep (likely via aws/aws-sdk-php for signing). FoodKing has no SSH/SFTP/SSH-key-auth functionality. No client-controlled OID parsing surface.
composer_per_cve.fix_path: DEFER V1.0.X — bump to 3.0.52+ at next routine update (transitively pulled by aws-sdk update).

composer_per_cve.title: Unsafe Deserialization in PHPT Code Coverage
composer_per_cve.surface: require-dev only — phpunit ships with composer install --dev. Production deployment uses composer install --no-dev → phpunit NOT installed in /vendor on prod server. CVE requires running phpunit with attacker-controlled .phpt files (CI only).
composer_per_cve.fix_path: NOT-APPLICABLE — blocked by Laravel 9 (phpunit ^9 pinned). Move to phpunit 9.6.33+ when CI Composer.lock refreshes within ^9.5.10 constraint, OR defer to Laravel 10+ migration (phpunit 10/11).

composer_per_cve.title: Local Privilege Escalation via CWD .psysh.php auto-load
composer_per_cve.surface: Requires running `php artisan tinker` (psysh interactive shell) in a directory where attacker can write `.psysh.php`. Production servers do not run tinker; dev-only.

composer_per_cve.title: Incorrect argument escaping under MSYS2/Git Bash (Windows)
composer_per_cve.surface: Platform precondition: Windows + MSYS2/Git Bash environment. FoodKing prod runs on Linux (per Ansible/OVH VPS-1 plan). Windows is dev-environment only.

npm_per_cve_priority.title: Prototype pollution + SSRF + Header injection + DoS + JSON tampering + CRLF injection + null byte
npm_per_cve_priority.surface: 133 callsites resources/js across kiosk/POS/admin/mobile/customer-web. Backend (Laravel) controls Origin so SSRF/header-injection gadgets need attacker-controlled config object — limited in FoodKing's strict backend-validated payloads. Prototype-pollution gadgets need both __proto__ pollution source AND target merge — FoodKing payloads are server-formed JSON. Real exposure: customer-facing surfaces (mobile + web ordering) where third-party content (CDN images, social, etc.) could enter URL params.
npm_per_cve_priority.exploit_difficulty: Medium — chained exploit requires polluted config + reachable merge. Most FoodKing axios calls use static config; risk concentrated in dynamic-URL flows.
npm_per_cve_priority.fix_path: FIX-PRE-PROD — `npm audit fix` available (non-breaking 1.15.2). DO NOT execute in audit-only scope; recommend for V1.0.X heal.

npm_per_cve_priority.title: Prototype pollution + code injection via _.template
npm_per_cve_priority.surface: Wide admin/POS/kiosk usage. _.template is the dangerous gadget (code injection via attacker-controlled template string + imports key). FoodKing usage: verify if any _.template() with user-controlled strings — likely .debounce/.throttle/.merge/.cloneDeep instead.
npm_per_cve_priority.exploit_difficulty: Low IF _.template used with attacker input; otherwise High.

npm_per_cve_priority.title: Hidden functionality (GHSA-8jh9-wqpf-q52c — version 8.19.1 specifically supply-chain compromise / malicious)
npm_per_cve_priority.surface: Bundled in public/js/vendor.js — exposed in every page that loads vendor.js (all admin + kiosk + frontend).
npm_per_cve_priority.exploit_difficulty: ALREADY compromised — supply chain CVE, not user-triggered. Anyone visiting affected page is exposed.
npm_per_cve_priority.fix_path: FIX-PRE-PROD URGENT — `npm audit fix` to 8.19.2+. Non-breaking patch.

npm_per_cve_priority.title: Prototype pollution
npm_per_cve_priority.surface: Used in 9+ Vue components: SliderComponent (frontend home), CheckoutComponent, CategoryComponent, ItemComponent (admin+table), KitchenDisplaySystem, ChatComponent, TableMenuComponent, admin POS ItemComponent. Exploit requires user-controlled swiper config — FoodKing usage is hardcoded options (no user-driven config merge).
npm_per_cve_priority.exploit_difficulty: High — needs attacker-controlled config merge path; not naturally present in carousel-only usage.
npm_per_cve_priority.fix_path: FIX-PRE-PROD via `npm audit fix --force` is BREAKING (swiper 12, major version). Verify breaking-change scope before commit. DEFER V1.0.X-EARLY if breaking-change validation needed (8 visual+technical Vue components to re-verify), OR accept risk DEFER V1.0.X.

npm_per_cve_priority.title: gRPC memory allocation + protobufjs UTF-8 decoding
npm_per_cve_priority.surface: Firebase JS SDK used for FCM messaging (push notifications) in FrontendNavBar + BackendNavbar. Firestore NOT used (FoodKing uses Pusher + Laravel Echo). gRPC + Firestore advisories may not apply if Firestore module unused at runtime.
npm_per_cve_priority.exploit_difficulty: Low IF Firestore used; Inert IF only Messaging used. Verify with bundle analysis.
npm_per_cve_priority.fix_path: DEFER V1.0.X — firebase@12.13.0 is BREAKING (3 major versions). Audit which Firebase modules are actually shipped before forcing upgrade. Likely candidate for V1.1 alongside Laravel migration.

npm_per_cve_priority.title: fetch credentials leak page-origin cookies instead of target-origin
npm_per_cve_priority.surface: Test environment only (Vitest DOM emulation). Not in browser runtime.

packages: bn.js / elliptic / browserify-sign / node-forge / create-ecdh (laravel-mix node-libs-browser polyfills)
ws / engine.io-client / socket.io-client (vitest fake-indexeddb test only)
build_time_only_dev_dependencies.verdict: NOT-APPLICABLE for prod browser runtime. CVEs only fire when running build/test. Heal at convenience.
